title: Answer ceiling
what: The most characters one tool answer holds and the one wording that says what was cut, held to the shared cases. Lives in src/tool/ceiling.rs.

title: Tool host call protocol
what: The tool host's protocol 1 as this repository speaks it: the session record of the host's API 0.1.0-rev.2 a call is handed, the call-back socket, the manifest held to each served entry, and what a record's tools keep. Lives in src/tool/.
